Valleys

Source: R/valleys.R
valleys.Rd

Detects different types of valleys, based on Silveira and Silveira (2020). The primary difference is the use of a rectangular local neighborhood shape instead of a circular one, in calculus of Black Top Hat (BTW) (Rodriguez et al. 2002). For more satisfactory results, it is recommended to define the moving window based on the minimum mappable area and function fill()

Usage

valleys(x, sp_range, c)

Arguments

x

Input DEM raster file.

sp_range

Numeric. Number of neighbor cells for multiscalar analysis.

type

Numeric. Each number represents a specific landform, for example: (1) Flat-bottomed Valleys, (2) Open Valleys, and (3) Incised Valleys
